scope: Live uncontrolled scene; observer and web are single-process services. No services paused or hardware controls changed. Browser rendering runs on the viewing computer.

definitions.cpu_percent: Percentage of all logical CPU capacity; 100% means all cores busy. Process CPU includes all threads. System idle and iowait are excluded from busy time.
definitions.ram: MiB = 1048576 bytes. System used = MemTotal - MemAvailable; process RSS is resident memory, PSS apportions shared pages. Combined app RAM sums PSS, not RSS.
definitions.peak: Largest sampled memory or interval CPU value in this window; not an instantaneous or lifetime peak.
definitions.workload: face_calls = face passes; hand_calls = hand pipeline updates; palm_calls = palm model invocations. These overlap and must not be summed as total neural inferences. Rates use observer uptime between counter snapshots.
definitions.sampling: Approximately 1 Hz /proc plus read-only /spatial HTTP polling; sampler overhead is included in whole-board metrics. Only counts and timings are retained from the camera API.

energy.reason: No exposed power/energy sensor and no external power measurement available.
energy.formula: Defined completed workloads / measured input joules, or matching workloads per second / average measured watts.
energy.limitation: CPU utilization and supply ratings cannot establish electrical energy or inferences per joule.

provenance.note: Board checkout HEAD alone does not identify running files: local runtime changes exist; source hashes identify sampled files. Hashes read during the measurement.

measurement_note: Second 60-second sample, after the initial sample had invalid observer snapshots. No runtime configuration or controls were changed between samples. All 61 snapshots were fresh. Both runs are retained; their uncontrolled scenes differ.
